items.name: Flank Steak
items.text: 1 lb Flank Steak, cut in strips

items.name: Green Onions
items.text: 1 bunch Green Onions, cut into small pieces

steps.text: Put cornstarch, water, eggs and salt and make a batter dip beef and fry till crispy. Drain on paper towels.
steps.text_plain: Put cornstarch, water, eggs and salt and make a batter dip beef and fry till crispy. Drain on paper towels.

steps.text: Next take a tbsp of oil and sauté 1/2 the minced garlic and ginger with all the veggies minus the broccoli.
steps.text_plain: Next take a tbsp of oil and sauté 1/2 the minced garlic and ginger with all the veggies minus the broccoli.

steps.text: Add all the remaining ingredients into the wok and stir fry then add the beef and coat it well.
steps.text_plain: Add all the remaining ingredients into the wok and stir fry then add the beef and coat it well.

steps.text: If it’s too runny add a cornstarch slurry to thicken it.
steps.text_plain: If it’s too runny add a cornstarch slurry to thicken it.

steps.text: Lastly get water to a rolling boil.
steps.text_plain: Lastly get water to a rolling boil.

steps.text: Throw in the broccoli for 2 min and immediately transfer to an ice bath.
steps.text_plain: Throw in the broccoli for 2 min and immediately transfer to an ice bath.

steps.text: Toss in with the beef and enjoy.
